title: Blessing of the Trickster
html:
Blessing of the Trickster is a Trickery Domain class action. This ability allows a cleric to improve the Stealth Checks of an allied creature.

Description

Grant another creature  Advantage on Stealth Checks.

Only affects one target at a time.
